_comment: Perk catalog for `dnd-cli loot roll` and `character item add`. GitHub issues #1, #9, #10. A perk is a prefix or a suffix on an item. `types` are the item types that can roll it. `rarity` is the lowest item rarity that rolls it. `until` is the highest (default: very rare). `weight` is the roll weight among the perks that fit. `group` is a set of perks that exclude each other on one item. `effect` is the id of a preset in dnd_cli/effects.py, or null. When `effect` is null, the DM must rule the perk: `ruling` says how, and `needs` names the engine part that is missing. A perk that is not in this list stays free text. `per_rarity` is how many perks an item rolls. A weapon of uncommon rarity and above always rolls an enchant perk (+1, +2, +3) first. Common items have no perk. Legendary items are written by the DM. Potions, scrolls and ammunition never roll perks. The catalog is written for this game after a study of how Baldur's Gate 3 spreads item properties by rarity and slot. It copies no names or text from that game. See combat-board.md, section 7.

perks.ruling: +1 to attack rolls and damage rolls with the weapon.
+2 to attack rolls and damage rolls with the weapon.
+3 to attack rolls and damage rolls with the weapon.

perks.name: Keen
perks.ruling: A weapon hit on a natural 19 or 20 is a critical hit.

perks.name: of Flame
perks.ruling: On a hit: +1d4 fire damage. The blade can light a fire.

perks.name: of Frost
perks.ruling: On a hit: +1d4 cold damage.

perks.name: of Storm
perks.ruling: On a hit: +1d4 lightning damage.

perks.name: of Purging
perks.ruling: On a hit against an undead or a fiend: +1d6 radiant damage.

perks.name: Vicious
perks.ruling: A critical hit with the weapon deals 7 more damage.
perks.needs: extra damage on a critical hit only

perks.name: Vampiric
perks.ruling: On a hit, the wielder regains 1d4 hit points.
perks.needs: healing the attacker on a hit

perks.ruling: +1 Armor Class.
+2 Armor Class.

perks.name: of Cushioning
perks.ruling: The wearer takes 1 less damage from each piercing, slashing and bludgeoning hit.

perks.name: Unyielding
perks.ruling: The wearer takes 2 less damage from every hit.

perks.name: of Warding
perks.ruling: +1 to saving throws.

perks.name: of Protection
perks.ruling: +1 Armor Class and +1 to saving throws.

perks.name: of Might
perks.ruling: +1 to Strength saves and Strength checks.

perks.name: of Agility
perks.ruling: +1 to Dexterity saves and Dexterity checks.

perks.name: of Vigor
perks.ruling: +1 to Constitution saves and Constitution checks.

perks.name: of Fire Resistance
perks.ruling: Resistance to fire damage.

perks.name: of Cold Resistance
perks.ruling: Resistance to cold damage.

perks.name: of Poison Resistance
perks.ruling: Resistance to poison damage.

perks.name: Blessed
perks.ruling: While the item is worn or wielded, the user has +1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws. It needs no concentration and no caster.

perks.name: of Alertness
perks.ruling: +2 to initiative rolls.

perks.name: of Swiftness
perks.ruling: +10 feet of walking speed.

perks.name: of Sorcery
perks.ruling: +1 to spell attack rolls and to spell save DC.
perks.needs: a spell DC and spell attack bonus from gear

perks.name: of Regeneration
perks.ruling: At the start of each of the wearer's turns in a fight, the wearer regains 1 hit point, if above 0.
perks.needs: healing at the start of a turn

perks.name: of Prowess
perks.ruling: One ability score of the wearer is at least 19 while the item is worn. The DM picks the ability that fits the item.
perks.needs: an ability score override from gear
